visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan and white Corgi is lying on its side on a light gray tiled floor in an indoor setting. To the left of the frame, a curved light brown rattan chair leg stands on the tiles. A person's right hand enters from the lower right and begins scratching the dog's thick fur on the inner part of its hind leg. The dog remains still with its head facing away from the camera. (2) The hand continues the scratching motion with rhythmic intensity. The dog briefly licks its nose and shifts its gaze, turning its head slightly towards the person with a side-eye expression. The background environment remains stable, showing the clean floor and the base of the furniture under bright, even indoor lighting. (3) The scratching stops for a brief moment, then the hand reaches further down the dog's thigh to resume the action. The Corgi maintains its relaxed lying position, appearing content and calm as it blinks slowly and observes the person's hand. The camera remains mostly steady in a high-angle shot throughout the interaction.
